snippet.title: CLAWSTROPHOBIA - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
CLAWSTROPHOBIA is a claw machine rogue-lite deckbuilder that traps players in the Japanese subway.

Your only way out is by paying off an impossible debt by capturing valuable prizes.

Increase your odds of escape by buying specialty drinks from the vending machine to trigger big combos! Synergise your drinks and change the way you play the machine for even larger payouts.

Pay off each escalating debt deadline and claw your way to freedom!
